original.target_description: Study 1: heavy versus light clipboards during job-candidate evaluation. Study identity is established, but the description and empty original locator do not distinguish overall suitability, serious interest, social likeability, own-task accuracy importance, or effort. Critical target test unresolved.

n.sample_role: Candidate only: participants in independent heavy/light Experiment 1 job-candidate suitability groups; not accepted as row-specific analytic N.
n.exclusions: Not documented in supplied main report; supporting material referenced but not supplied.

notes: Identity independently checked: title Incidental Haptic Sensations Influence Social Judgments and Decisions; authors Joshua M. Ackerman, Christopher C. Nocera, John A. Bargh; Science 328 (2010), pp. 1712–1715; DOI 10.1126/science.1189993. This is the primary published report, not an abstract or preregistration; it also includes an unrelated preceding article fragment. No PDF supplied. Supporting Online Material is referenced but absent from the supplied text. Study 1 was identified by the explicit first-study narrative, not numeric matching or input order. Multiple outcomes satisfy the neutral description: overall candidate suitability F(1, 52) = 4.08, P = 0.049; serious interest F(1, 52) = 4.40, P = 0.041; own-task accuracy importance F(1, 52) = 4.96, P = 0.030; social likeability and effort each F < 1. These are distinct tests; each printed p is exact and belongs only to its named test. No d is printed in the inspected Study 1 main-report results/Table 1. Missing supporting material prevents a whole-work absence claim. No effect conversion performed. Candidate analytic N for Table 1 suitability: mutually exclusive heavy-prime 26 participants + light-prime 28 participants = 54. Exclusions not documented. Narrative recruitment of 54 passersby is separate corroboration, not itself analytic evidence. The group sum is retained only for parent field-scope review because the row-specific critical outcome is ambiguous; n.value remains null and target_match remains null. Unassigned replication, p, and success fields are placeholders.
